entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2130632159136095104: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 2.0319 +/- 0.0344 mas (same row, RUWE 1.26): 492.14 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -4.411, -15.220 mas/yr. Radial velocity from No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 2130632159136095104 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 200,000 of its distance per century.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.74 +/- 0.04 solar radii from Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of KOI-13 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract). Mass 1.72 +/- 0.1 solar masses from Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of KOI-13 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract). Temperature 7650 +/- 250 K from Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KOI-13 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 7,650 K, because kepler-13 B lies 1.2 arcsec away and gives 47% of the light (WDS 19079+4652, Mason et al. 2001): every spectrum and catalogue color of the star blends the two, so the color is taken from its own temperature, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #e8ebff. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 7,650 K and log g 4.19 (u1 0.280, u2 0.345): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
